image_description: An underwater close-up shot of a grey whale's head and anterior body. The image highlights the characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches (callosities). The arched rostrum and one visible pectoral flipper are prominent. The lighting is dim, typical of underwater photography, with particulate matter in the water.
